notes: הִנְנִי אֵלֶיךָ read as a verbless clause with a prepositional predicate: the copula *am* goes to אֶל and heads there (rule 49); the competing reading would put *am* on הִנֵּה, but rule 49 is settled for the ordinary copular case.
The vocative construct הַר takes the supplied *O* into its own unit (rule 36); the 1cs suffix of אֲדֹנָי is unrepresented, the ASV writing only *the Lord*.
